subject: Product impact interview — coordinating a 45min discovery chat
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Product impact interview — coordinating a 45min discovery chat

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for agreeing to be considered for a customer profile. We'd love to set up a 45-minute discovery interview to capture how Nybridge is using Redwood Inference, the measurable outcomes you're seeing, and any implementation lessons that might help other teams.

High-level goals for the call (we can tweak):
- 5 min intros and context
- 15 min product/process: how the integration was built, model choices, infra setup
- 15 min outcomes: metrics, cost/latency impact, business outcomes
- 10 min quotes, photos, and logistics (recording consent + approvals)

Proposed windows next week (PT):
- Tue 2027-01-12, 10:00–10:45 or 14:00–14:45
- Wed 2027-01-13, 11:00–11:45

If those don't work, send over two alternatives or pick directly: https://cal.com/naomi/45min

I'm attaching a short prep agenda and a list of suggested discussion prompts. If you have an internal contact who should join for the outcomes discussion (e.g., someone from analytics), please loop them in. Also: we usually record these interviews for internal transcription and to pull short quotes for the case write-up — would you be comfortable with that?

Attachments: nybridge-prep-agenda.pdf, nybridge-questionnaire.docx

Thanks — talk soon.

—Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

- 14:05–14:20: outcomes & metrics (Marcus + Rajiv)

Thanks again — looking forward to it.
